references.text: Aaron offers the sin offering bull for himself and his household, an elaboration on what was mentioned in verse 6
The priest shall offer a young bull as a sin offering for his own sin
Aaron shall make atonement for himself and the people by offering a sin offering
Moses brought forward the sin offering bull, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head
The high priest must offer sacrifices for his own sins as well as for the people's sins
The Levitical high priests had to first offer for their own sins, then for the people's. Christ did not need this
The high priest entered the Most Holy Place once a year, not without blood, which he offered for himself and for the people's sins
